name: slice-agents-and-vocabulary
title: Ship the slice roles as agents, coach GREEN with habit-hooks, and hold code to one DDD vocabulary
outcome: A slice built with /implement:start gets structural coaching while GREEN writes, and a vocabulary verdict beside its score, against one root glossary that design mode keeps current.
done_when: `plugins/implement/agents/` holds red, green, validate, and vocabulary agents, and both slice-loop paths spawn them by name
A GREEN file write returns habit-hooks coaching as additionalContext, and no other agent receives it
`DDD-VOCABULARY.md` is the one glossary, design mode reads and writes it, and `CLAUDE.md` points to it
abort_if: Claude Code gives a PostToolUse hook no way to tell the GREEN agent from other agents
habit-hooks coaching on every write makes a GREEN attempt slower than the slice loop can accept

min_work.derived_from: A review of mattpocock/skills and habit-hooks/habit-hooks, and the engineer's decisions in one chat session
min_work.note: Written by hand. Design mode did not run. The engineer dropped four of six candidate ideas in chat. intent.json, assessment.json, narrative.json, and pr-draft.md are absent on purpose.

epics.note: ADR-0025 narrows the install-surface rule so implement may ship agents and hooks. Slice 1.
RED, GREEN, and VALIDATE as plugin agents, spawned by name. Slices 2 and 3.
A required PostToolUse hook runs habit-hooks for GREEN only, with credit to habit-hooks. Slices 4 and 5.
DDD-VOCABULARY.md, the vocabulary agent, design mode read and write, and the CLAUDE.md table move. Slices 6 to 8.
